name: Road to Shu
material: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk
dimensions: Painting only: 187 x 256.5 cm (73 5/8 x 101 in.); Overall with knobs: 270 x 284 cm (106 5/16 x 111 13/16 in.)
summary: Few works by the Yuan workshops in Yangzhou present a continuous composition of such monumental scale as this hanging scroll.
